title: Australia: card surcharge reset
changed: eftpos, Mastercard and Visa no-surcharge rules apply from 1 October after the RBA removed its prohibition on those rules.

title: Domestic interchange: lower caps
changed: Revised interchange regulation applies to domestic-issued card transactions acquired in Australia.

title: Issuer compensation rules change
changed: The amended net-compensation regime starts, with transitional arrangements for 2026/27.

title: Scheme fees come into view
changed: First quarterly aggregate fee publications by designated card networks were due for the July–September period.

title: Acquirer fee disclosures begin
changed: Qualifying large acquirers must publish merchant service fee data by merchant size and card type.

title: Next: prove interchange pass-through
changed: First publication of large acquirers’ interchange pass-through measures covers October–December 2026.
hits: Large acquirers and merchant finance teams

title: Foreign-issued cards get a cap
changed: Interchange caps extend to foreign-issued card transactions acquired in Australia.

title: Merchant statements get sharper
changed: More statement detail is required from the first full statement period starting on or after 1 April.

title: Scheme-fee roadmap expected
changed: The RBA expects a scheme-fee roadmap by 1 April; this is an expectation, not a new fee cap.

title: NZ moves on commercial cards
changed: The 22 October decision introduces commercial credit-card interchange limits on Mastercard and Visa.

title: Same Day ACH: $10 million limit
changed: Nacha lists an increase of the Same Day ACH dollar limit to $10 million for 17 September 2027.
hits: US treasury, payout and originating-bank teams

title: ACH credits: 9am availability
changed: Non-Same Day ACH credits must be available by 9am in the receiving bank’s local time on settlement date.

title: ACH: IAT definition changes
changed: Nacha lists its revised definition of International ACH Transactions among the September changes.

title: ACH availability exceptions update
changed: Nacha lists changes to funds-availability exceptions for Non-Same Day credit entries. Check the rule text before changing controls.

title: IAT: optional date-of-birth field
changed: Nacha lists the optional date-of-birth field for IAT entries for 19 March 2027.
hits: IAT originators, banks and service providers

title: ACH: register IAT contacts
changed: Registration of IAT contacts in the ACH Contact Registry is listed for 1 January 2027.

title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
changed: Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November.

title: UK fee transparency: next stage
changed: Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension.

title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
changed: ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge.
hits: UK acquirers and scheme billing teams

title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
changed: Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions.

title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
changed: The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here.
hits: EU payment providers; not automatically UK firms

title: CHAPS: November release deferred
changed: The Bank of England deferred its entire November 2026 RTGS standards release. This notice does not establish a replacement deadline.

title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November
changed: Payments Canada confirms a scheduled 9 November launch. This preview does not describe the service as already live.
hits: Canadian banks, PSPs and payment users

title: Canada–EU: interlink work supported
changed: A joint commitment supports work toward connecting instant payment systems. It is not an operating cross-border route.

title: Pix DICT: refund monitoring default
changed: DICT 2.13.0 changes the default value of Refund MonitorAccount to false. Review integrations for implicit defaults.
hits: Pix participants and refund engineering teams

title: Pix DICT: recovery API clarifications
changed: The September release candidate adds FundsRecoveryId path-parameter documentation and clarifies refund-request restrictions. A release candidate is not a compliance deadline.

title: 3DS 2.4: draft, not a mandate
changed: EMVCo reports that draft Protocol and Core Functions v2.4 is available for Associate and Subscriber review. No global migration deadline is asserted.
hits: 3DS servers, SDK providers and authentication teams

title: 3DS approvals: conditional extension
changed: EMVCo’s Q3 update reports conditional approval extensions for eligible products intending to migrate to v2.4.0.0. Confirm product-specific eligibility.

title: Agentic payments: intent framework draft
changed: EMVCo’s draft framework introduces Intent Services for consumer-authorised intent. It is a specification-development step, not a deployed network mandate.
hits: Agentic checkout and payment product teams

title: Reg II: proposal watch, not a new rate
changed: The Federal Reserve proposal docket is the source to monitor. No final rate, litigation outcome or effective date is asserted in this preview.
hits: US debit economics and regulatory teams

title: PSD3: a separate Council milestone
changed: The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline.
hits: EU payment and e-money institutions; not automatically UK firms
